## ✨ 本次更新
### 📌 新增贴图功能
- 支持将剪贴板内容以“贴图”形式悬浮在屏幕上，方便随时对照参考。 - 该功能默认关闭，请前往「高级 - 界面 - 贴图」手动开启。 - 开启后，拖动来源图标即可将内容随意贴在屏幕任意位置，打造你的专属桌面便签。
### ☁️ iCloud 同步提速
- 优化 iCloud 同步速度，大幅减少多端数据同步的等待时间。 - 提升同步响应效率，让剪贴板历史在不同设备间流转更迅速、更及时。
### 📱 移动端新版本发布
- iOS 新版本已上架，带来更流畅的使用体验。 - 针对移动端深度优化了 iCloud 同步速度与同步策略，弱网环境下表现更稳定。 - 与 Mac 端协同更紧密，确保跨设备剪贴板内容实时一致。
---
## ✨ What's New
### 📌 Pin to Screen
- You can now pin clipboard items as floating overlays on your screen for easy reference. - This feature is disabled by default. Enable it via Advanced → Interface → Pin to Screen. - Once enabled, simply drag the source icon to place content anywhere on your screen.
### ☁️ Faster iCloud Sync
- Improved iCloud sync speed to significantly reduce waiting time across devices. - Enhanced sync responsiveness so clipboard history transfers more quickly and reliably.
### 📱 Mobile App Update
- A new version of the IOS app is now available with a smoother experience. - Optimized iCloud sync speed and strategy on mobile for better performance, even on slower connections. - Tighter integration with Mac ensures real-time consistency of clipboard history across all devices.

# ✨ 本次更新
## ☁️ iCloud 同步优化
* iCloud 同步现在支持自定义文本同步大小，可根据需要调整同步范围。 * 修复大文本同步时可能导致同步队列卡死的问题，提升同步稳定性。
## 📱 移动端同步策略调整
* 优化移动端同步策略，减少不必要的同步操作，提升使用体验和同步效率。
赶快更新体验吧！✨
---
# ✨ What's New
## ☁️ iCloud Sync Improvements
* iCloud Sync now lets you choose the maximum text size to sync, giving you more control over synced content. * Fixed an issue where syncing large text content could cause the sync queue to become stuck.
## 📱 Mobile Sync Strategy Updates
* Updated the sync strategy on mobile devices to reduce unnecessary sync operations and improve overall efficiency.
Update now and enjoy a more stable syncing experience! ✨
- 🐛 优化性能以及修复部分已知问题 - 🐛 Optimized performance and fixed some known issues
